summary.text: Charlotte Friedman is the Republican candidate for New York State Senate District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Erik Bottcher.
She was also the Republican candidate in the February 3, 2026 special election for the seat, which Bottcher won.

paragraphs.text: Friedman ran in the special general election for District 47 on February 3, 2026, in which Erik Bottcher received 91.7 percent of the vote (13,325 votes) and Friedman received 7.7 percent (1,117 votes), according to Ballotpedia.
She advanced to the November 2026 general election after Ballotpedia reports the June 23, 2026 Republican primary was uncontested.
Her campaign website lists opposition to socialism, combating antisemitism and public safety among its issues.

sources.title: Charlotte Friedman: Putting New York First
